'''7L-VN''' was a [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] that was often used to assist [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
7L-VN is a droid in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures]] that follows players around. It was only available during a promotional event on July 11, 2011. Players had to buy a [[:w:c:clonewarsadventures:Station Cash#Station Cash cards|Station Cash card]] from 7-Eleven and redeem it for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's virtual [[:w:c:clonewarsadventures:Station Cash|Station Cash]] currency the same day to receive this droid as a reward.<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures video game">{{WebCite|url=http://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=869|text=Get a 7-Eleven Droid|work=the official [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']] website|archivedate=20110715201432}}</ref>

7L-VN's name therefore resembles "7-Eleven".
